create_image_feature: create a tfds Image feature with shape, dtype, and encoding format for dataset definitions
encode_image_example: encode an image from numpy array, file path, PIL image, or bytes into serialized tf example format
decode_image_example: decode serialized image bytes back into a TensorFlow tensor with the configured shape and dtype
decode_image_numpy: decode image bytes into a numpy array using OpenCV or PIL with proper channel reordering and reshaping
generate_video_html: generate HTML video or GIF representation from a sequence of image frames for dataframe visualization
